messages:
Jules: dropped a prototype for partial export + preview pagination. figma: https://figma.redwood/partial-export-proto :eyes:
Avery: nice. main problem we keep hearing: users want to download just the previewed page (e.g., 50 rows) not entire selection. current Export always queues whole selection which is surprising
Hannah: agree. propose default Export action is 'Export page (50 rows)' and then a small chevron to expand options: Export selection / Export all / Export page. keeps accidental huge exports down
Marco: backend: easy enough to support page-scoped exports. we can compute estimate for page quickly and only enqueue the requested slice. still need to show schema_v and whether breakdowns are included
Sam (PM): timeline: can we land the page-first behavior for next patch? customers keep filing tickets about accidental exports of millions of rows 
Jules: UX details: - primary kebab default action = Export page - if selection differs from page show badge "Selection: 3,200 rows" - export modal shows three radio options and estimated size per option
Avery: accessibility nits: keyboard flow: kebab -> Export -> radio group -> confirm. make sure radio has aria-describedby with size info. SR should announce "Exporting page: 50 rows (~0.4 MB)" when option selected
Hannah: copy suggestion: change 'Export vectors' to 'Export (page / selection / all) (.csv)'. In modal header show a one-line summary: "Exporting page: 50 rows — includes IDs and vectors. Toggle metadata & breakdowns."
Marco: we'll add an endpoint to return per-slice byte estimates and the exact CSV header. UI will call it when opening the panel to show precise numbers before queuing
Sam (PM): also want a small inline note for partial exports: "Partial exports don't count against export quota" to reduce confusion. Ops will implement quota attribution accordingly
Jules: visual tweak: make the Export page option the default and surface an unobtrusive warning when selecting Export all: "Exporting all 3,200 rows (~120 MB) may take several minutes" with a Confirm checkbox to prevent accidental clicks
Avery: keyboard/voice: when the confirm checkbox appears, screen reader must announce why it's required. Use aria-live polite for the warning copy so it doesn't interrupt navigation
Hannah: small test cases: NVDA + VoiceOver flows for selecting Export page, toggling breakdowns, and ensuring focus returns to kebab on close. Also test that link to sample CSV header is readable by SRs
export-bot: note: queued export (page) will create a lightweight job with higher priority than full exports. full exports default to low-priority background queue
Marco: infra will implement prioritized buckets and return signed links + size metadata. ETA: quick API patch this sprint, queue work next sprint
Sam (PM): consensus: make Export page default, surface selection count, show size per option, include schema_v in CSV, add confirm for large exports, SR announcements and keyboard flows. Good work. I'll add to release notes
Jules: updating figma and the accessibility checklist now, will ping when frames + keyboard GIF uploaded :slightly_smiling_face:
Avery: thanks all 44D closing thread
